summary: Controlled membership account view: digital card, plan and summary, payment, status and usage, invoices, and preferences.
whenToUse: In a community account area to summarize membership, billing, and preferences.
whenNotToUse: To collect or process payments: the pattern displays presentational data and notifies the consumer of selections.
To execute privacy requests or save consents: the application integration must handle those actions.

props.name: member
props.description: Identity and metadata shown on the digital card.

props.name: plans
props.description: Presentational monthly and yearly labels and amounts.

props.name: orderSummary
props.description: Total, discount, and coupon status; does not perform checkout.

props.name: couponInput
props.description: Controlled field and callbacks to enter/apply a coupon; the consumer handles validation and response.

props.name: paymentMethods
props.description: Already available payment methods to display and select.

props.name: selectedPaymentMethodId / onPaymentMethodChange
props.description: Controlled method selection; does not collect card data.

props.name: subscription
props.description: Status, next billing date, and optional usage.

props.name: invoices
props.description: Invoice history rows, with an optional consumer-provided link.

props.name: communicationPreferences / onCommunicationPreferenceChange
props.description: Controlled preferences; the consumer decides whether and how to save them.

props.name: onRequestDataExport / onRequestDeletion
props.description: Optional request button callbacks; no request is executed or confirmed by the pattern.

keyboard.action: Reaches plan controls, payment methods, preferences, and actions.
Activates the focused cadence or action; native radios follow browser behavior.

accessibility: Sections have headings; card, radio controls, switches, and invoice table keep native semantics.
Cadence is indicated by aria-pressed in addition to visual styling; states are labeled with text in Badges.
Usage is exposed with the progress element and an accessible name.
responsive: Panels adapt to the container; invoice history scrolls horizontally on narrow viewports.
customization: Data, callbacks, surfaces, spacing, states, and typography are provided by the consumer or --dc-* tokens.
commonMistakes: Expecting the pattern to charge, update, or persist data: all mutations remain the consumer's responsibility.
Interpreting export or deletion callbacks as confirmation of completion: they are only request handlers.

examples.name: ControlledMembership
examples.title: Controlled membership
examples.description: Card, monthly/yearly switch, and local callbacks for selections and requests.

limits: Does not perform checkout, collect payment data, or save consents.
Privacy callbacks only notify the consumer; the pattern does not state that an export or deletion has occurred.
Monetary values and dates are formatted by the consumer.
